why:
I checked both must_not items against the verifier and builder briefs, and neither is broken.

Item 1: Check 3 cannot pass when only padLeft is documented. It lists every exported function and requires "every exported function name listed (at least capitalize, slugify, truncate, padLeft)" to have a section. It also adds "check slugify in particular."

Item 2: I found no condition stricter than its line. Check 1 tests only the padding outputs and fills of one character, so it never requires fill to be one character. It confirms the declaration takes "(s, width, fill)", which mirrors the line's own signature rather than counting parameters. Check 2 matches its line. Check 3 asks for "a heading naming that function with text under it", which is just what a section is, with no fixed layout. Check 4 needs only exit 0 and no failing tests. The builder's README style choices sit outside any PASS/FAIL condition, and the test-content and invoice-example checks are marked advisory.
